candidate_query:
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.331'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND trim(cr.clausesAffected) <> ''
MATCH (cr)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(target:Release)
MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
WHERE rk.specRelease = target.releaseName
WITH DISTINCT cr, rk
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(rk)
WHERE cr.clausesAffected CONTAINS s.sectionNumber
WITH cr, s
WHERE (
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+|[A-Z]' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b)\\s*(?:(?i:sub-?clauses?|clauses?|sections?|annex(?:es)?)\\s+)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\.?\\s*(?:\\([^)]*\\)\\s*)?(?:$|[,;\\n&]|\\band\\b).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '([0-9].*|[A-Z]\\..*)' AND NOT s.sectionNumber =~ '[0-9]+'
      AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?<![A-Za-z0-9._/#:~\\-])\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E(?![A-Za-z0-9_]|\\.[A-Za-z0-9]).*'))
    OR
    (s.sectionNumber =~ '[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9-]+' AND cr.clausesAffected =~ ('(?s).*(?:^|[,;\\n&])\\s*(?:[0-9][A-Za-z0-9.]*\\s*[–\\-:(/]\\s*)?\\Q' + s.sectionNumber + '\\E\\s*\\)?\\s*(?:$|[,;\\n&]).*'))
  )
RETURN DISTINCT cr.tdocNumber AS tdocNumber
ORDER BY tdocNumber
